photos_low_quality.label: Photos are low quality
photos_low_quality.explanation: Some photos are blurry, dark or too small. Please upload clear, bright photos of the actual property.

photos_not_property.label: Photos don't show the property
photos_not_property.explanation: Please use only photos of this property — no stock images, maps, logos or pictures of other places.

photos_watermark_other_site.label: Photos have another site's watermark
photos_watermark_other_site.explanation: Some photos carry the logo or watermark of another website. Please upload your own original photos.

price_unrealistic.label: The price looks unrealistic
price_unrealistic.explanation: The price is far from what similar places cost. Please check the amount, the currency and the period (night, month or total price).

description_contact_info.label: Contact details in the text
description_contact_info.explanation: Please remove phone numbers, links, emails and usernames from the title and description. Guests contact you with the contact buttons.

description_incomplete.label: The description is incomplete
description_incomplete.explanation: Please describe the property in more detail: the rooms, its condition, what's included and the house rules.

wrong_location.label: The location is wrong
wrong_location.explanation: The pin on the map or the city doesn't match the property. Please move the pin to the right place.

wrong_category.label: Wrong category
wrong_category.explanation: The deal type or property type doesn't match this property. Please choose the right one.

duplicate_listing.label: Duplicate listing
duplicate_listing.explanation: This property is already listed. Please edit your existing listing instead of posting it again.

suspected_scam.label: Suspected scam
suspected_scam.explanation: This listing shows signs of a scam, so it can't be published. If you think this is a mistake, please contact our support team.

prohibited_content.label: Content not allowed
prohibited_content.explanation: The listing includes content that our listing rules don't allow. Please check the rules and remove it.

discriminatory_terms.label: Discriminatory wording
discriminatory_terms.explanation: Listings may not limit who can rent or buy (for example by religion, origin or gender). Please describe the property and its features instead.

other.label: Other
other.explanation: Please read the note from our team and update your listing.

risk.duplicate_photos_other_account: Same photos in another account's listing
risk.duplicate_photos_same_account: Same photos in another listing by this owner

DRAFT.label: Draft
DRAFT.description: Not published yet. Finish the steps and publish when you're ready.

IN_REVIEW.label: In review
IN_REVIEW.description: We're checking your listing — usually within a day.

NEEDS_CHANGES.label: Needs changes
NEEDS_CHANGES.description: Our team asked for a change. Edit the listing and send it again.

LIVE.label: Live
LIVE.description: Your listing is on the site and guests can contact you.

PAUSED.label: Paused
PAUSED.description: Hidden from the site for now. You can turn it back on at any time.

EXPIRED.label: Expired
EXPIRED.description: This listing is no longer shown. Renew it to put it back on the site.

RENTED.label: Rented
RENTED.description: Marked as rented and hidden from search.

SOLD.label: Sold
SOLD.description: Marked as sold and hidden from search.

REJECTED.label: Rejected
REJECTED.description: This listing can't be published. See the reason, or contact support.

HIDDEN.label: Hidden
HIDDEN.description: Hidden after reports from visitors. A moderator is checking it.

inReview.title: We're checking your listing
inReview.message: We're checking your listing — usually within a day.

errors.invalid_status: This can't be done while the listing is in its current status. Please refresh the page and try again.
errors.missing_requirements: Some required details are missing. Please complete the highlighted steps.
errors.rules_not_accepted: Please accept the listing rules before publishing.
errors.wrong_deal_type: This action doesn't match the deal type of this listing.
errors.phone_not_verified: Please verify your phone number first — it only takes a minute.

requirements.location: Choose the city and mark the location on the map
requirements.details: Add a title and the property details
requirements.contact: Add a way to contact you
